description: This file defines the MyLeaveEntitlementReport class in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component with leave period data for rendering the leave entitlement report.

classes.name: MyLeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: A controller class responsible for preparing and rendering the leave entitlement report component, utilizing leave period data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares leave period data and binds it to the Vue component for rendering the report.
